name: AnnounceKit
description: AnnounceKit is a powerful tool for managing and distributing product updates and announcements. It helps businesses keep their users informed with real-time notifications and changelogs, enhancing user engagement and satisfaction.

events.d: Creates a post in a project with title and content, plus publishing schedule, visibility, audience targeting, labels, and advanced options.

events.n: When a new activity occurs on a post, project, or feature request
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new activity occurs on any post, project, or feature request.

events.n: When a new comment is added to a post
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new comment is added to the specified post.

events.n: When a new post is created
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new post is created in the specified project.

events.n: When a new reaction, vote, or score is added
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new reaction, vote, or score is added in the selected project or on a specific post.

events.n: When a new feature request is created
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new feature request is created in the selected project.
Runs when a new subscriber is added
Retrieve a project's posts (announcements) as a paged list, with optional filters for labels, search query, creator, status, and sorting.
List projects in your AnnounceKit account.
List all labels in a project.
List a project's audience segments with each segment's title and targeting rules.
Publish a draft post in a project now or schedule it; set visibility, expiration, push, pin, feedback, and pause options.
Fetch a specific post from a project.
Delete a post from an AnnounceKit project.
